forcedChoices.reason: The English capitalizes the first word, a noun; Spanish needs the article, so both words are in capitals.
First person singular of the author kept; impersonal 'se' avoids a choice of gender for the author.
'mated' of persons; 'aparearse' reads as animal breeding in Spanish.
'her eldest son': Spanish 'su' cannot show that the son is the Mother Eve's, so 'de ella' keeps the English sense.
'present status'; 'actual' is avoided as a false friend in this project.
'life realization' means making life real; 'toma de conciencia' (the glossary form for realization of God) does not fit here.
